lxc_dbc97c6e95c7e115.text: An October date can bring very different celebrations.

lxc_0006a333c3d559d1.text: The place and the reason help you understand what people do.

lxc_750472c2564fc057.text: October has different special days in different countries.

lxc_9e39d1d27bd32292.text: Halloween is on 31 October, with activities in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

lxc_c59bccd95f8d4223.text: Canadian Thanksgiving is on the second Monday of October in Canada.

lxc_ff7e0a97b3b22e32.text: German Unity Day is on 3 October in Germany.

lxc_6c526c1d6a683882.text: These dates belong to the same month, but their reasons are different.

lxc_a22041bfa05461f1.text: Halloween brings costumes and candy, Thanksgiving celebrates the harvest, and German Unity Day remembers a change in the country.

lxc_7afd85174d184fe8.text: On Halloween, people wear costumes in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

lxc_7dc2e4318e87e14d.text: A costume is clothing that makes someone look like another person or thing.

lxc_204c055fe4266c65.text: For example, someone can dress as a witch or a ghost.

lxc_47fc572bd963f375.text: Some costumes are scary, and others are funny.

lxc_3696076f71a470da.text: Adults also wear costumes and go to costume parties.

lxc_95e1a2d0f611ad16.text: At these parties, dressing up is part of the fun.

lxc_670ed734b61e8840.text: Halloween is not a national day, and it is not a family harvest meal.

lxc_9bd65258bdd67130.text: Children go from door to door for Halloween trick-or-treat.

lxc_4c14226949a9fc77.text: They visit neighbours and say “Trick or treat!”

lxc_e4a1cbf2eb58b04d.text: This activity takes children to several homes, rather than keeping them in one place.

lxc_6f8d3ac1457f269a.text: People also carve pumpkins, cutting pieces out to make faces.

lxc_0177518c9f238dac.text: A light inside makes the face shine in the dark.

lxc_f7ab3eab4f22f5e3.text: Costumes, visits, and bright pumpkin faces all help make the evening special.

lxc_58b0f667f543992d.text: Canadian Thanksgiving follows a Monday rule, not one fixed date.

lxc_61a5c9e375085224.text: It is on the second Monday of October.

lxc_7be25d8ce0adbf90.text: In 2026, 1 October is a Thursday, so 5 October is the first Monday and 12 October is the second Monday.

lxc_041e55c3a814e67a.text: This makes 12 October the holiday date in 2026.

lxc_f48cfa5984454ea3.text: It is a harvest holiday, celebrating food grown on farms, and a day off in most of Canada.

lxc_a09f6ba5cac03cac.text: Families sit down together for a big meal.

lxc_62cd6c4ce4091766.text: Turkey is a common main dish, with side dishes and pumpkin pie.

lxc_1f9043dad5862598.text: People give thanks for the harvest and the year.

lxc_b0d3b5c1f84be1ae.text: This is not United States Thanksgiving, which is in November, and it is not a costume celebration or Germany’s national day.

lxc_e73d4a291beb6ff8.text: German Unity Day is on 3 October.

lxc_6b729f1bc790e558.text: Its German name is Tag der Deutschen Einheit.

lxc_139158a7146b03a0.text: It is Germany’s national day, a special day for the whole country.

lxc_730deee27ecce064.text: Germany was once divided into East Germany and West Germany.

lxc_50745423fee7df17.text: Their official names were the German Democratic Republic and the Federal Republic of Germany.

lxc_1f97d7544d8b628e.text: After protests, the Berlin Wall opened on 9 November 1989.

lxc_eae44ecc0a073951.text: On 3 October 1990, East Germany joined West Germany, and the country was one again.

lxc_4e39fa57566bae59.text: This joining is called reunification, and German Unity Day remembers it.

lxc_df7701752867e13b.text: German Unity Day is a public holiday, so people have the day off.

lxc_f21a7caa4e0a8d29.text: Many towns have public gatherings, where people meet to mark the day together.

lxc_6dcb8cb38350b930.text: Each year, one German state hosts the main celebration.

lxc_5f7f78a2825524e0.text: Its city-centre festival runs from 2 to 4 October.

lxc_d3e583b214fa5c00.text: Berlin also has events near the Brandenburg Gate, a famous city landmark.

lxc_49c9ab8b2e617a70.text: People see flags and hear speeches about the country and its history.

lxc_9ebee1000b8a7334.text: Costumes and a harvest feast are not part of this holiday.

lxc_56ce75e2961defbc.text: It is a national celebration, not a food festival or a costume day.
